botToken.label: Discord bot token
botToken.helpText: Token of the Discord bot that creates and deletes the posts (see the README for the bot's permissions). Reddit shows this setting to every moderator of the subreddit. Leave empty to pause relaying.

forumChannelId.label: Discord forum channel ID
forumChannelId.helpText: The Forum channel the posts go to. In Discord: turn on Developer Mode, right-click the forum channel, Copy Channel ID. Leave empty to pause relaying.
